Batch prep

Choose one flavor direction, prep the pieces that belong together, and keep proteins and greens fresh. Each plan gives you three distinct bowls without asking you to make everything in the book.

About 60–75 minutes · 3–5 days of useful components

The 3–5 day rhythm

Prep components, not finished bowls.

Days 1–3
Use the cooked grain and roasted vegetables first. Keep each component in its own shallow, covered container.

Days 4–5
Lean on pickles, sauces, toasted crunch, Pacha and freshly cut vegetables. Freeze extra cooked food before day four if it will not be used.

Every dinner
Cook protein fresh, open tinned fish fresh, and dress greens only at serving. USDA advises using most cooked leftovers within 3–4 days.
